Accomplishment
1. Co-established the Lai Ho & Wu Cho-liu Endowed Chair in Taiwan Studies at UCSB(台灣研究-賴和與吳濁流講座教授) 2004

2. One of the Key Co-founders of the Taiwanese American Foundation of San Diego and Taiwanese American Community Center (TACC) in 1997, (聖地牙哥台美基金會董事) 2003-2011

3. Started and chaired the Culture and History Lecture Series (which was re-named Ed Cheng Culture and History Lecture Series in 2015), Book Club and Understanding Science Lecture Series in TACC 1998-2015

4. Secretary of the Formosan Association for Human Right 1979-1980

5. Authored and published poetry books (“綠色瞬間”(麥田出版社);“練習詩”(城邦印書館) )

6. Research Science in various international Fusion Energy Technology Programs

7. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 10/2018
